mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.decision = 'accept' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount FROM trigger_event t JOIN agent_session s ON t.platform = s.platform AND t.bot_id = s.bot_id AND t.group_id = s.group_id WHERE s.persona_id = #{personaId} AND t.trigger_kind = 'internal' AND t.occurred_at >= #{since}

SELECT m.content FROM memory_entry m JOIN agent_session s ON m.platform = s.platform AND m.bot_id = s.bot_id AND m.group_id = s.group_id WHERE s.persona_id = #{personaId} AND m.memory_type = 'preference' AND m.status = 'active' AND m.occurred_at >= #{since}

SELECT e.label AS label, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, AVG(e.intensity_after) AS avgIntensity FROM emotion_log e JOIN agent_session s ON e.platform = s.platform AND e.bot_id = s.bot_id AND e.group_id = s.group_id WHERE s.persona_id = #{personaId} AND e.occurred_at >= #{since} GROUP BY e.label ORDER BY totalCount DESC
